questions.question: Before I refactor the upload path I need to know how you want failures handled. The current code retries three times with a fixed delay, swallows the last error and marks the file as uploaded anyway, which is why the Files pane sometimes shows files that never reached storage. Which behaviour do you want?

options.label: Retry with backoff (Recommended)
options.description: Retry five times with exponential backoff, then surface the error

options.label: Fail fast
options.description: Report the first error to the user immediately
